entries.exEn: Hi, Marta, how's it going?
How's your day going today?

entries.ex: Tienes un trabajo nuevo, ¿qué tal te va?
entries.exEn: You have a new job, how's it going?
Hi, Pablo, how's everything going?

entries.en: What are you doing? (these days, later)
entries.exEn: What are you doing this afternoon?

entries.en: What are you doing right now?
entries.exEn: I'm calling you, what are you doing?
Hi, Ana, what are you up to?

entries.ex: ¿Qué tal el fin de semana en la playa?
entries.exEn: How was your weekend at the beach?
What plans do you have for the summer?

entries.en: So, tell me, what is new?
entries.exEn: Hi, Luis, what's new with you?
"How's it going, Pablo?" "Fine, and you?"
I'm very well, thanks.

entries.ex: Voy tirando, pero estoy un poco cansado.
entries.exEn: I'm getting by, but I'm a bit tired.

entries.ex: Hoy estoy muy liada con el trabajo.
entries.note: Very common in Spain: estoy liado/a.
entries.exEn: Today I'm very busy with work.

entries.ex: No hemos hecho nada especial hoy.
entries.exEn: We haven't done anything special today.

entries.ex: En casa, lo de siempre: trabajo y más trabajo.
entries.exEn: At home, the usual: work and more work.
My Spanish is going pretty well.
How was the exam? So-so.
I slept terribly last night.
How nice! You have a holiday.

entries.ex: ¡Qué pena! No puedo ir a tu fiesta.
entries.exEn: What a pity! I can't go to your party.
You're going to Madrid? You don't say!
Really? I didn't know that.
I'm very glad to see you.
Oh dear, I don't have my phone.

entries.ex: Ya veo que tienes mucho trabajo.
entries.exEn: I see that you have a lot of work.

entries.ex: Claro, te ayudo con la maleta.
entries.exEn: Sure, I'll help you with the suitcase.

entries.ex: Por supuesto, puedes venir a mi casa.
entries.exEn: Of course, you can come to my house.
Well, I'm going home.

entries.ex: Pues no sé, voy a pensarlo.
entries.exEn: Well, I don't know, I'll think about it.

entries.ex: Llego a las diez, o sea, en una hora.
entries.exEn: I'll arrive at ten, I mean, in an hour.
Come on! Let's go to the cinema.
I'm off, see you on Monday!

entries.ex: Hasta luego, Marta, te llamo mañana.
entries.exEn: See you later, Marta, I'll call you tomorrow.

entries.ex: Adiós, Luis, que te vaya bien.
entries.exEn: Goodbye, Luis, all the best.
Have a good trip and take good care of yourself.

entries.ex: ¿Te vas a la fiesta? ¡Que lo pases bien!
entries.exEn: Are you going to the party? Have a good time!

entries.ex: Hola, soy Tim; encantado de conocerte.
entries.exEn: Hi, I'm Tim; nice to meet you.
You speak very well, where are you from?

entries.en: What do you do for a living?
entries.exEn: And you, what do you do for a living?

entries.en: How long have you been here?
entries.ex: Hablas muy bien, ¿cuánto tiempo llevas aquí?
entries.exEn: You speak very well, how long have you been here?
Excuse me, do you speak English?
I didn't understand you, can you repeat that?
Speak more slowly, please.
How do you say "charger" in Spanish?
What does this word mean?

entries.ex: No lo sé, te digo algo mañana.
entries.exEn: I don't know, I'll let you know tomorrow.

entries.ex: ¿Vamos a la playa? Depende del tiempo.
entries.exEn: Shall we go to the beach? It depends on the weather.

entries.ex: Da igual el restaurante, vamos a cenar.
entries.exEn: The restaurant doesn't matter, let's have dinner.

entries.ex: Me da igual ir hoy o mañana.
entries.exEn: I don't mind going today or tomorrow.

entries.ex: No puedo hablar porque tengo prisa.
entries.exEn: I can't talk because I'm in a hurry.

entries.ex: Perdona, llego tarde por el metro.
entries.exEn: Sorry, I'm running late because of the metro.
Hi, Ana, what's new?
Hi, Carmen, how are you?

entries.ex: Hola, Juan, ¿cómo te va en Madrid?
entries.exEn: Hi, Juan, how are things going in Madrid?

entries.es: Hace mucho que no te veo
entries.en: I haven't seen you for ages
entries.ex: ¡Hola, Pedro! Hace mucho que no te veo.
entries.exEn: Hi, Pedro! I haven't seen you for ages.
Long time no see! How are you?

entries.ex: Mucho gusto, soy el nuevo vecino.
entries.exEn: Pleased to meet you, I'm the new neighbour.
"Nice to meet you." "Likewise."

entries.ex: Dale un abrazo a tu madre.
entries.exEn: Give your mother a hug from me.

entries.ex: Me encanta esta ciudad, ¿y a ti?
entries.exEn: I love this city, what about you?

entries.ex: Soy de los Países Bajos, pero vivo en Madrid.
entries.exEn: I'm from the Netherlands, but I live in Madrid.
I work in a small company.
I'm on holiday for two weeks.

entries.ex: Estoy aprendiendo español en una escuela.
entries.exEn: I'm learning Spanish at a school.

entries.en: I've been here for two weeks
entries.ex: Llevo dos semanas aquí y me gusta.
entries.exEn: I've been here for two weeks and I like it.
I like this neighbourhood a lot.

entries.ex: Me encanta pasear por esta ciudad.
entries.exEn: I love walking around this city.
Do you like living here?

entries.en: Do you have brothers or sisters?
entries.exEn: Do you have brothers or sisters, or are you an only child?

entries.note: Verb right after the question word; not «¿Dónde tú vives?».
entries.exEn: Where do you live now?

entries.ex: No te preocupes, yo te espero.
entries.exEn: Don't worry, I'll wait for you.

entries.ex: Si llegas tarde, no pasa nada.
entries.exEn: If you arrive late, it's no problem.
Sorry, I didn't see you.
I'm sorry, I can't today.

entries.ex: Cenamos a las nueve, ¿qué te parece?
entries.exEn: We'll have dinner at nine, what do you think?

entries.ex: Me parece bien quedar a las ocho.
entries.exEn: Meeting at eight sounds fine.
How come? Why aren't you coming?
Oh, really? I didn't know that.

entries.ex: Es verdad, hoy hace mucho calor.
entries.exEn: That's true, it's very hot today.
Let's see, what time is it?

entries.ex: Un momento, por favor, busco las llaves.
entries.exEn: Just a moment, please, I'm looking for the keys.
By the way, have you talked to Marta?
You're going to the Canaries? How lucky!
How strange! Juan isn't answering.
Congratulations on the new job!
You're leaving tomorrow, aren't you? Have a good trip!

entries.ex: Hasta el lunes, ¡buen fin de semana!
entries.exEn: See you on Monday, have a good weekend!

entries.ex: Gracias por todo y hasta pronto.
entries.exEn: Thanks for everything and see you soon.
Thank you very much for your help.
